settings.title: Removes sweat, grime, spf and other environmental stressors
Ingredients
settings.richtext:
Microbiome Supportive Ingredients:

  • TeraFluid Light: Breaks down grime and sunscreen while optimizing the absorption of nourishing oils and antioxidants, supporting a deeply cleansed yet balanced complexion.
  • Betaine: Helps maintain the skin’s natural moisture balance, ensuring a gentle cleanse that removes dirt and sunscreen without causing dryness or irritation.
  • Squalane: Replenishes essential moisture lost during cleansing, offering antioxidant protection against environmental stressors and leaving skin soft, calm, and comfortably hydrated.

Other positive ingredients:

  • Trehalose: Prebiotic that offers protection against skin dehydration and environmental stress by maintaining cell integrity and reducing inflammation.
  • Sucrose Stearate: Serve as a gentle surfactant that enhance the product's texture and stability, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
  • Glycerin: Enhances skin hydration and has potential antibacterial effects against Staphylococcus epidermidis, which can protect and maintain the skin’s microbiome balance.
  • Camellia Oleifera (Camellia) Seed Oil: Provides antioxidant effects and combats pathogens like E.coli and C. albicans.
  • Saccharomyces Ferment: Saccharomyces cerevisiae produces antimicrobial peptides with bioactivity against foodborne pathogens like C. albicans, C. krusei, E. coli, L. monocytogenes, and Salmonella spp. It also produces mycocin to target against other yeast species.
  • Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Oil: Helps maintain healthy skin barrier and inhibits growth of pathogenic S. aureus in atopic dermatitis and supports the growth of beneficial bacterium such as S. epidermidis and enhance production of lactic acid.
  • Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Oil: Shown antibacterial activity against pathogenic bacteria S. aureus and increase microbial diversity while maintaining stability in vitro.
  • Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil: Support the microbiome with activity against bacterial pathogens including skin pathogen Staphylococccus aureus. Also has antifungal activity against dermatomycetes, fungi that may cause skin or nail infections.

Glycerin, Sodium Cocoyl Apple Amino Acids, Sucrose Stearate, Betaine, Saccharomyces Ferment, Aspergillus Ferment, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Oil, Squalane, Tocopherol, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Oil, Camellia Oleifera Seed Oil, Spirulina, Platensis Extract, Trehalose, Sodium Citrate

See for more information on our ingredients page.

settings.title: How to Use
settings.richtext:
Step 1:
After a long day, sweat sesh, or time spent in the sun. Apply 1-2 pumps of barrier balancing cleanser to dry or wet face. Rub into skin to release grime.

Step 2:
Add water to skin as cleanser begins to froth into a milky texture, helping further cleanse and hydrate your skin.

Step 3:
Towel dry skin. For best results, apply Deeper Dive Hydrator post-cleanse
